test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting in the middle of the sides of the table.

D is sitting third to the left of E. D is sitting at one of the corners. H is not sitting at any corner. G is sitting second to the right of H. H is not sitting immediate next to D. Only three persons are sitting between B and A. B is sitting immediate next to F. B is not sitting in the middle of any side.

Who is sitting third to the left of G?
solution:
**Given:**

A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre. 

D is sitting third to the left of E

D is sitting at one of the corners

H is not sitting at any corner, H is not sitting immediate next to D

G is sitting second to the right of H
